title: Bhakti Saints Nimbark
definition: Nimbarka was a 13th-century Telugu philosopher and theologian who founded the Nimbarka Sampradaya, advocating the philosophy of Dvaitadvaita (Dualistic Non-dualism).
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the evolution of Vaishnavism, the philosophical transition from Shankara's Advaita to Ramanuja's Vishishtadvaita, and the regional spread of Bhakti movements.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Bhakti Saints Nimbark.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
